example.title: Asbury United Methodist Church (1950 building; congregation 1891)

brief: Postwar Gothic Revival church in rock-faced ashlar limestone: a steep gable-front nave with a pointed tracery window and buttresses, and a square stone tower at the front corner topped by a slender slate-grey spire and cross. A 1.5-storey education wing with a sided gable and dormer steps down beside the tower; brown asphalt roof. Out front, the old 1891 bell sits on a stone plinth in a planted bed.
